hook.name: B420MemeHook
hook.description: Singleton Uniswap v4 hook for graduated B420 meme token pools. Collects protocol fees and creator taxes on each swap via afterSwap with a return delta, optionally converts memecoin-denominated fees to the quote currency inline per-swap, and supports a buyback-and-lock mechanism that swaps accumulated quote fees back into the memecoin and vests them in a five-year buyback vault.
